assumptions: This review uses only the supplied packet; no tools, files or commands were accessed.
Workers are trusted. Findings concern accidental omissions, stale evidence and ordinary filesystem failures.
The packet does not establish an additional mechanism that reconciles proposal blockers across stages or binds rendered-page hashes to the PDF used by the renderer.
checks: Inspected preservation, change attribution, hash verification, deterministic validation, proposal readiness and supplied proposal tests.
The reported 197 passing tests support control-plane verification; they do not establish accounting correctness or human acceptance.
Confirmed that proposal_gate retains implementation_enabled=false and human_acceptance=pending.
issues: P1 — Preservation can silently omit unreadable directories. In scripts/accounting_master_support.py, editable_files uses os.walk without onerror, so directory enumeration failures are silently ignored. preserve_editable can therefore return a successful but incomplete backup inventory; changes_since and contributed_changes can subsequently misclassify omitted files. worker_inventory explicitly raises traversal errors, but that does not make the separate preservation traversal fail closed. Repair: give editable_files a raising onerror callback and propagate inventory failures as continuation vetoes before editable work. Add a targeted traversal-error regression verifying that incomplete preservation cannot authorize work.

P2 — Earlier proposal blockers can disappear from final readiness without a recorded resolution. In scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py, P15–P17 accept decisions with blocks_proposal=true. P19 recursively checks those stages using their original non-final rules, then applies decisions(final=True) only to its own open_decisions. An empty P19 list therefore passes even when an upstream decision remains explicitly blocking. Repair: reconcile upstream blocking decision IDs against explicit final dispositions, requiring a supported resolution or superseding decision for each blocker. Add a regression where an upstream blocker is omitted from P19 and verify that readiness fails; also cover an explicit resolution.

P2 — Render evidence is not bound to the PDF that produced it. P18 independently hashes rendered_pages and checks only that the worker-authored rendered_pdf_sha256 equals the current PDF reference. After a rebuild, updating the PDF/build records and that scalar while retaining old page images and render-review references passes these checks. The supplied test covers a mismatched scalar and an empty page list, but not stale pages accompanying a newly pinned PDF. Repair: require a render record binding the renderer's input PDF hash to its output page hashes, and bind the render review to that record. Add a regression that rebuilds and repins the PDF while retaining the prior render record/pages; it must fail until rendering and review evidence are refreshed.
next_actions: Make editable inventory traversal fail closed.
Require explicit reconciliation of upstream proposal blockers.
Bind render outputs and their review to the exact rendered PDF.
Run the targeted regressions and controller suites, then obtain a fresh review of the changed controls.
residuals: The implementations of process containment, locking, acceptance finalization and approval-rule installation are not supplied here; their stated interfaces and test names cannot independently establish their correctness.
The accepted 192-report source panel and scoped internal phase acceptance leave accounting, scientific and human-acceptance gaps open.
Structural evidence checks cannot establish substantive design quality; independent result review remains necessary after these repairs.
steps: Compared the supplied evidence functions and proposal checker against preservation, freshness and honest-readiness requirements.
Separated concrete code findings from unsupplied interface implementations and semantic-review limitations.
summary: REVISE: preservation can silently omit files, final readiness can omit upstream blockers, and render evidence can remain stale after a PDF rebuild.
